description: One synthetic black 64x48 intra frame per codec, generated locally by system FFmpeg 7.1.5 with libx264/libx265; test data, not linked dependencies. SEI removed. RTP clock=90000, rate=25.
generation: ffmpeg -f lavfi -i color=c=black:s=64x48:r=25 -frames:v 1 -c:v libx264 -preset ultrafast -tune zerolatency -x264-params keyint=1 -f h264 sample.h264
ffmpeg -f lavfi -i color=c=black:s=64x48:r=25 -frames:v 1 -c:v libx265 -preset ultrafast -x265-params pools=none:frame-threads=1:log-level=error:keyint=1 -f hevc sample.h265
